submitted.rationale: It had the highest EQE of the three merit measurements: 0.0687% at 2.06 eV. The other two were index 90 (0.0608%) and index 145 (0.0426%). EQE went up as Fe increased and Cr decreased. The strong XRD peaks near Q 1.88, 2.66 and 3.57 look like SnO2 from the substrate. Index 90 and 145 also showed the same extra peaks, possibly an Fe-vanadate phase; the phases were not identified.
